summary: Master RPA with UiPath & Automation Anywhere. Build bots, reduce costs, and drive digital transformation. 5-day intermediate course for analysts & developers.
lede: Robotic process automation (RPA) training helps process analysts, developers and operations leads identify and build workflows for repetitive business tasks. It covers assessing automation candidates, creating workflows with UiPath and Automation Anywhere, and managing exceptions, bot deployment and governance. The course also addresses practical considerations such as legacy-system integration, security and competing IT priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to identify, design, and deploy automation solutions to drive operational efficiency and digital transformation. Business Process Analyst:
audience: Identify RPA candidate processes and map workflows
RPA Developer: Build, test, and deploy automation
IT Operations Manager: Oversee bot deployment strategies
Digital Transformation Lead: Set automation strategy
Process Owner: Define process requirements and validate
RPA Solution Architect: Design end-to-end automation architectures
Compliance Officer: Ensure RPA solutions meet data
Data Analyst: Analyze process data to optimize
Change Manager: Drive stakeholder adoption and manage
Quality Assurance Specialist: Test bot performance
modules: Advanced UiPath Automation and UI Interaction
Intelligent Process Automation and AI Integration
RPA Strategy, ROI, and Change Management
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of business process concepts and basic computer literacy. No prior coding experience is required, but familiarity with Excel or SQL is beneficial. Participants must bring a laptop with Wi-Fi access. The course is delivered at an Intermediate level, focusing on operational application and hands-on implementation of RPA tools.
